answer: Recurring memory-hard puzzles: every epoch each identity must solve a fresh puzzle that needs about a gigabyte of RAM for a few seconds, and the puzzle seed is released only at the epoch start, so work cannot be stockpiled. An honest agent pays that once per epoch, a small toll on the bridge. A farmer with a thousand clones needs a thousand gigabytes at the same moment, every epoch, as far as the horizon goes, so each fake pushes him nearer the ledge where hardware costs exceed any reward.
